n_pairings.source: The CS‑US pairings were repeated four times with variable intertrial intervals (ITIs) on average at 120 seconds.

tone_duration_s.source: During the fear conditioning, animals were placed into the chamber and received pairings of auditory CS (20 seconds, 65 dB, 10 kHz) and electric shock US after a baseline period (120 seconds).

apparatus.value: square transparent Plexiglas chamber with a grid floor (O'Hara & CO., LTD., Tokyo, Japan) which is in a sound‐isolating box (Muromachi Kikai CO., LTD., Tokyo, Japan)
apparatus.source: In context A, animals were placed in a square transparent Plexiglas chamber with a grid floor (O'Hara & CO., LTD., Tokyo, Japan) which is in a sound‐isolating box (Muromachi Kikai CO., LTD., Tokyo, Japan).

species.source: Male (average weight at testing: 445.87 g; total N = 101) and female (average weight at testing: 267.32 g; total N = 99) Sprague Dawley rats were purchased from a commercial breeder (Charles River) and acclimated to the vivarium for 7 d before the start of handling.

strain.source: Male (average weight at testing: 445.87 g; total N = 101) and female (average weight at testing: 267.32 g; total N = 99) Sprague Dawley rats were purchased from a commercial breeder (Charles River) and acclimated to the vivarium for 7 d before the start of handling.

shock_intensity_ma.source: Each rat received footshocks representing one of the following three shock intensities: 0.3 mA (mild shock intensity), 0.5 mA (moderate shock intensity), or 1 mA (high shock intensity).

n_pairings.source: Following a 5 min baseline period with no stimulus presentations, the rats were sequentially exposed to a total of seven CS–US pairings (Fig. 1A).

tone_duration_s.source: As CS, we used a 30 s 4 kHz tone played in each chamber by a speaker at ∼75 dB as measured at the center of the chamber (∼20 cm from the speaker).

apparatus.value: sound-attenuating conditioning chambers (model H10-24A Rat Test Cage, Coulbourn Instruments), consisting of Plexiglas, metal walls, and a metal grid floor for the delivery of footshocks (model H10-11R-TC Shock Floor, Coulbourn Instruments)
apparatus.source: They were then placed in sound-attenuating conditioning chambers (model H10-24A Rat Test Cage, Coulbourn Instruments), consisting of Plexiglas, metal walls, and a metal grid floor for the delivery of footshocks (model H10-11R-TC Shock Floor, Coulbourn Instruments).
